pages.text: $(bold)Where a thing lives sets its tier.$()$(br2)A boss or structure's tier is decided by the dimension it generates in — not by how hard it is. This is $(bold)location-based tiering$():$(br)$(li)$(t1)T1$() — the Overworld$(li)$(t2)T2$() — Twilight Forest, Aether, Blue Skies$(li)$(t3)T3$() — Nether and deep dimensions$(li)$(t4)T4$() — the End and endgame dimensions

$(bold)Two big departures from vanilla:$()$(br2)The $(bold)Nether is Tier 3$() content. The $(bold)End is Tier 4$() content.$(br2)Both are far deadlier here than vanilla. The Nether stays sealed until you reach Tier 3 — a portal won't ignite before then. The End has its own Tier 4 key (see the last page).

$(bold)Tier 2 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$() — Dense, dark, ambush-heavy. Bosses guard progression. Home of the first Simply Swords uniques.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$() (Everbright + Everdawn) — Elemental combat. Mobs deal elemental damage that bypasses standard armor.$(br2)$(bold)The Aether$() — Aerial warfare. Vertical combat, thin platforms, falling is lethal. Ranged builds shine here.

$(bold)Tier 3 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)The Undergarden$() — Toxic attrition. Constant poison pressure. Survival builds matter.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper and Darker$() — Horror survival. Noise attracts mobs. Sculk mechanics. Stealth has value.$(br2)$(bold)The Nether$() — Relentless aggression. Everything is permanently aggro. Piglins hunt in packs.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss: The Other Side$() — Optional Tier 3 dimension.

$(bold)Tier 4 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)Deep Aether$() — Ascension trial. Aerial combat plus elite AI. Celestial Events every 20 minutes empower all mobs.$(br2)$(bold)The End$() — Three escalating zones: Outer Islands → Deep End / End Cities → Dragon's Domain. The End is designed to kill you. $(italic)Prepare accordingly.$()

pages.title: Reaching the End
pages.text: The vanilla stronghold-and-portal process still applies, but with one change: the Eye of Ender is replaced by an $(bold)End Compass$(), crafted from $(bold)Deep Aether$() materials.$(br2)So you must work Deep Aether — a Tier 4 dimension — before you can even locate the End portal. The compass then points you to an $(bold)End Bastion$().$(br2)$(bold)The finale:$() defeating the $(t4)Ender Dragon$() ends the tier ladder and opens the post-game (the Ad Astra planets).
